english.meaning: to have something to eat or use
english.note: 有得飯食 'there is food to eat; a living to be made'. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: I have an ID card. I hardly ever get to use it, so what?
exampleSentences.traditional: 我有身份證𡃉，難得有得用，吹呀。
